label: YS-25
title: Promised 'ultimate gate' zero-haircut assertion is absent from ResetAndRewire post-assert: users' principal guarantee has no on-chain enforcement
description: SkimAndLeg1Migration.s.sol lines 433-434 document: 'The Phase-5 `staker_realized == staker_booked` assert is the ultimate gate.' The comment is presented as a definitive safety backstop ensuring users receive 100% of their booked principal (zero haircut) from the V2 re-deposit in Leg2. However, ResetAndRewire.s.sol (the Phase-5/step-3 script executed between Leg1 and Leg2) contains NO such assertion anywhere in its post-assert block (lines 271-325). The post-asserts present are: (a) dolaP <= dolaIdleSwept (over-credit prevention), (b) dolaIdleSwept == 0 || dolaP > 0 (sweep fired), (c) yieldStrategy(DOLA) == ysDolaV2 (correct wiring), and (d) dolaTotalStaked == 0 (pool reset). Identical for USDC. None of these prove `staker_realized == staker_booked`. The only mechanism providing the zero-haircut guarantee is the off-chain fork-preview run described in _printSummary — operator judgment, not machine enforcement. If the Phase-4 prefund was insufficient (due to integer truncation per finding 88331e64, stale snapshot, or minter position change between estimation and execution), no on-chain gate prevents Leg2 from migrating users at a haircut. The comment's promise ('THIS is the definitive gate') is factually false — it describes a gate that does not exist.
impact: If Phase-4 prefunding under-delivers (by any amount, including 1-wei truncation or a larger stale-estimation gap), users will receive less than 100% of their booked principal when Leg2 re-deposits into the V2 strategy. There is no on-chain mechanism to catch this before Leg2 executes. The only safeguard is operator discipline in running a fork preview — which is exactly the practice the comment implies has been superseded by an on-chain gate. The gap creates silent user principal loss with no revert path.
recommendation: Add a `staker_realized == staker_booked` assertion to the ResetAndRewire post-assert block for each token: after the prefund sweep is complete, read `ysDolaV2.totalBalanceOf(DOLA, ORIGINAL_STABLE_STAKER)` and compare to `ysDolaV2.principalOf(DOLA, ORIGINAL_STABLE_STAKER)`. Also read `poolInfo(DOLA).totalStaked` to compare against the newly credited principal. Hard-revert if realized < booked. Also update SkimAndLeg1Migration comment to accurately describe where the gate lives. If a per-user guarantee is required, the gate should be applied per-staker entry in Leg2Migration rather than only at the aggregate level.
